help.privacy.title: Privacy
help.privacy.body: All files are processed in your browser. Nothing is uploaded, and the app sends no data to any server.
help.browser.title: Browser requirements
help.browser.body: Use a recent Chrome, Edge, or Opera. The app needs the File System Access API, which Firefox and Safari do not have yet.
help.progress.title: Saving progress
help.progress.body: Sort folders, photo mappings, copy/move mode, and the operation log are saved in nata-sort-db.json inside the folder you open. Delete that file to start over.
help.safety.title: File safety
help.safety.body: The default mode is Copy, so original files are untouched. Files are never overwritten: an existing name gets a _1, _2, … suffix. The last sort can be undone with Ctrl/Cmd+Z.
